أَفْقَمُ ; fem. فَقْمَآءُ: see 1. ―
-b2- Hence, (assumed tropical:) Anything crooked, distorted, or uneven. (TA.) And أَمْرٌ أَفْقَمُ (tropical:) An affair, or a case, of a crooked kind; contrary to what is right. (S, * K, * TA.) ―
-b3- [And Freytag adds, from the Deewán of the Hudhalees, Difficult, as an epithet applied to a thing: ―
-b4- and, as a signification of the fem., A calamity, or misfortune.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
